description: This file defines the interface for a Windows-specific implementation of a Gatekeeper communication channel, which uses named pipes for IPC/RPC communication. It declares the class GatekeeperWindowsChannel with methods for sending requests and responses, receiving messages, and managing pipe connections.

classes.name: GatekeeperWindowsChannel
classes.description: A class implementing a Windows-specific communication channel for Gatekeeper IPC/RPC over named pipes, inheriting from GatekeeperChannel.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of GatekeeperWindowsChannel with a given pipe handle.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message over the pipe with a specified command.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message over the pipe with a specified command.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the pipe.

methods.name: WaitForConnection
methods.description: Waits for a connection on the specified pipe handle.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over the pipe with specified command and response flag.

methods.name: ReadFromPipe
methods.description: Reads data from the pipe into a buffer.
